## Stone Pudding (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
 N Huge ooze  
 **Init** -5; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft.; Perception -5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 3, touch 3, flat-footed 3 (-5 Dex, -2 size)  
 **hp** 236 (11d10+126);  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** -2, **Will** -2  
 **Defensive Abilities** split (fire, 10 **hp**); **Immune** fire, mind-affecting effects, ooze traits  
 **Weaknesses** racial vulnerabilities  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft. (4 squares), climb 20 ft.  
 **Melee** slam +11 (2d6+3 plus grab plus 1d6 acid, plus petrifying touch)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** acid, constrict (2d6+4 plus 1d6 acid), petrifying touch  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 17, **Dex** 1, **Con** 22, **Int** X-, **Wis** 1, **Cha** 1  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +13; **CMD** +18  
 **Skills** Climb +11, Stealth -13 (-3 when hiding on stone surfaces); **Racial Modifiers** +10 Stealth on stone  
 Languages—  
 **SQ** split  

**Special Abilities**

 **Acid (Ex)** A stone pudding secretes a digestive acid that dissolves organic material and stone, but not metal. Any melee hit or constrict attack deals acid damage.
